````js
  const top = UNDO[UNDO.length - 1];
  if (top && top.code === code) return;
  const now = performance.now(), sel = [ta.selectionStart, ta.selectionEnd];
  // a run of typing is one step; a pause, or a jump to somewhere else, starts the next
  if (top && now - lastKept < 700 && UNDO.length > 1 && Math.abs(sel[0] - top.sel[0]) <= 2) { top.code = code; top.sel = sel; }
  else { UNDO.push({ code, sel }); if (UNDO.length > 300) UNDO.shift(); }
  lastKept = now; REDO.length = 0; keysUI();
}
function restore(v) {
  restoring = true;
  ta.value = v.code; ta.setSelectionRange(v.sel[0], v.sel[1]); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event("input"));
  restoring = false; keysUI();
}
function undo() { if (UNDO.length < 2) return; REDO.push(UNDO.pop()); restore(UNDO[UNDO.length - 1]); }
function redo() { const v = REDO.pop(); if (!v) return; UNDO.push(v); restore(v); }
const baseRender = window.render;
window.render = function () { baseRender(); keep(); suggestSoon(); window.dispatchEvent(new Event("sprout-render")); };

// ===================================================================== moving the caret
function moveBy(n) { const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(ta.value.length, ta.selectionEnd + n)); ta.focus(); ta.setSelectionRange(p, p); suggestSoon(); }
function moveLine(d) {
  const v = ta.value, p = ta.selectionEnd, start = v.lastIndexOf("\n", p - 1) + 1, col = p - start;
  let target;
  if (d < 0) { if (start === 0) return; const prevStart = v.lastIndexOf("\n", start - 2) + 1; target = Math.min(prevStart + col, start - 1); }
  else { const end = v.indexOf("\n", p); if (end < 0) return; const nextEnd = v.indexOf("\n", end + 1); target = Math.min(end + 1 + col, nextEnd < 0 ? v.length : nextEnd); }
  ta.focus(); ta.setSelectionRange(target, target); suggestSoon();
}

// ===================================================================== brackets close themselves
const PAIRS = { "[": "]", "(": ")", '"': '"' };
function inText(before) { const line = before.slice(before.lastIndexOf("\n") + 1); return (line.replace(/\\./g, "").match(/"/g) || []).length % 2 === 1; }
ta.addEventListener("beforeinput", e => {
  if (TWEAK) return;
  const s = ta.selectionStart, en = ta.selectionEnd, v = ta.value, next = v[en];
  if (e.inputType === "insertText" && e.data && e.data.length === 1) {
    const c = e.data;
    // typing the closer that is already there steps over it
    if ((c === "]" || c === ")" || (c === '"' && inText(v.slice(0, s)))) && next === c && s === en) { e.preventDefault(); ta.setSelectionRange(s + 1, s + 1); return; }
    if (PAIRS[c] && !(c === '"' && inText(v.slice(0, s))) && (!next || /[\s\])},]/.test(next))) {
      e.preventDefault(); const sel = v.slice(s, en);
      insertText(c + sel + PAIRS[c]); const p = s + 1 + sel.length; ta.setSelectionRange(p, p); return;
    }
  }
  // deleting the opener of an empty pair deletes both
  if (e.inputType === "deleteContentBackward" && s === en && s > 0 && PAIRS[v[s - 1]] === next) { e.preventDefault(); ta.setSelectionRange(s - 1, s + 1); insertText(""); }
});

// ===================================================================== suggestions
let namesCache = null, namesFor = "";
function allNames() {
  if (namesFor === code && namesCache) return namesCache;
  const names = new Set();
  for (const m of code.matchAll(/(^|[\s\[(|,])([a-z][\w-]*[?!]?)(?=\s*:)/gim)) names.add(m[2]);   // names bound in the program
  for (const m of code.matchAll(/\b[a-z][\w-]*\b/gi)) if (m[0].length > 2) names.add(m[0]);
  for (const k of Object.keys(S.globals)) names.add(k);
  const P = S.internals && S.internals.PROTOTYPES;
  if (P) for (const kind in P) for (let o = P[kind]; o; o = Object.getPrototypeOf(o)) { if (o === Object.prototype) break; for (const k of Object.keys(o)) if (/^[a-z]/.test(k)) names.add(k); }
  ["start", "update", "draw", "game", "dt", "input", "touching", "tapped", "touch-x", "touch-y", "else", "print", "true", "false", "quote", "script", "yield"].forEach(n => names.add(n));
  namesFor = code; namesCache = [...names];
  return namesCache;
}
const MODULES = () => (S.stdlib ? S.stdlib.names : []).concat(["json"], S.libraries ? S.libraries.names : []);
// a library's words are known before it loads, so suggestions don't load it
function libraryWords(m) { const L = S.libraries && S.libraries.LIBRARIES[m]; if (!L) return null; try { return Object.keys(L.words(new Proxy(function () {}, { get: () => () => {}, apply: () => ({}) }))); } catch (e) { return []; } }
function moduleWords(m) { const lw = libraryWords(m); if (lw) return lw; try { const mod = S.globals[m]; return mod && mod.fieldNames ? mod.fieldNames() : []; } catch (e) { return []; } }
// what is being typed: the word before the caret, and the word before that (a module name, perhaps)
function context() {
  const p = ta.selectionStart; if (p !== ta.selectionEnd) return null;
  const before = ta.value.slice(0, p), line = before.slice(before.lastIndexOf("\n") + 1);
  if (inText(before) || /--/.test(line.replace(/"[^"]*"/g, ""))) return null;
  const m = /([a-z][\w-]*)?$/i.exec(line), prefix = m[1] || "";
  const prev = /([a-z][\w-]*)\s+$/i.exec(line.slice(0, line.length - prefix.length));
  return { prefix, prev: prev ? prev[1] : "", at: p - prefix.length };
}
function suggestions() {

// ===================================================================== the Live sheet: history, speed, run as you type
css.textContent += `

const VKEY = () => "sprout3.versions." + (curEx || "untitled");

function rememberVersion() {

  const n = versions.length, at = browsing >= 0 ? browsing : n - 1;
  const v = versions[at];

"Version " + (at + 1) + " of " + n + " · " + ago(v.at) + " · " + diffNote(versions[n - 1].code, v.code) + " from now" : n + " versions so far · drag back to play an older one"}</div>` +
      (browsing >= 0 ? `<div class="seg2" style="margin-top:8px"><button id="lsKeep">Keep this version</button><button id="lsNow" class="on">Back to now</button></div>` : "")
      : `<div class="hist">Each version that runs is kept here. Change something to start.</div>`) +
    `<div class="lbl">Two players</div><div class="seg2"><button id="lsNet">${window.NET && NET.active ? "Connected · player " + NET.me : "Play with a friend"}</button></div>` +
    `<div class="lbl">Speed</div><div class="seg2">${[0.25, 0.5, 1, 2].map(k => `<button data-sp="${k}" class="${SPEED === k ? "on" : ""}">${k === 0.25 ? "¼" : k === 0.5 ? "½" : k}×</button>`).join("")}</div>` +
    `<div class="lbl">While you type</div>` +
    `<div class="sw"><span>Run as I type</span><button class="tg${autoRun ? " on" : ""}" id="lsAuto" aria-label="run as I type"></button></div>` +
    `<div class="sw"><span>Values beside the code</span><button class="tg${valsOn ? " on" : ""}" id="lsVals" aria-label="values beside the code"></button></div>`;
  const h = $("lsH");
  if (h) h.oninput = () => { const k = +h.value; if (k === versions.length - 1) { backToNow(); return; } browseTo(k); };
  const on = (id, f) => { const e = $(id); if (e) e.onclick = f; };
  on("lsX", closeSheet); on("lsNet", () => { if (window.NET && !NET.active) { closeSheet(); NET.invite(); } }); on("lsNow", backToNow);
  on("lsKeep", () => { const k = browsing; browsing = -1; versions.push({ code: versions[k].code, at: Date.now() }); LS.set(VKEY(), versions); toast("Kept version " + (k + 1)); sheetUI(); });
  sheet.querySelectorAll("[data-sp]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { SPEED = +b.dataset.sp; toast(SPEED === 1 ? "Normal speed" : SPEED < 1 ? "Slow motion " + b.textContent : "Fast " + b.textContent); sheetUI(); });
  on("lsAuto", () => { autoRun = !autoRun; LS.set("sprout3.autoRun", autoRun); if (autoRun) runCode(); sheetUI(); keysUI(); });
  on("lsVals", () => { valsOn = !valsOn; LS.set("sprout3.values", valsOn); showValues(); sheetUI(); });
}
function setSource(src) { const st = ta.scrollTop; ta.value = src; code = src; ta.scrollTop = st; render(); queueSave(); runNow = true; try { if (window.tryBuild(src)) renderState(); } finally { runNow = false; } }
function browseTo(k) { browsing = k; setSource(versions[k].code); sheetUI(); }
function backToNow() { if (browsing < 0) return; browsing = -1; setSource(versions[versions.length - 1].code); sheetUI(); }
function openSheet() { sheetUI(); sheet.classList.add("on"); $("bLive").classList.add("on"); }
function closeSheet() { sheet.classList.remove("on"); $("bLive").classList.remove("on"); }
$("bLive").addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { e.preventDefault(); sheet.classList.contains("on") ? closeSheet() : openSheet(); });
document.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { if (sheet.classList.contains("on") && !sheet.contains(e.target) && !e.target.closest("#bLive")) closeSheet(); }, true);

// ===================================================================== the value of a selection
// select an expression and the key bar shows its value, worked out with the program's names (and game, the state now)
let probe = null, probeT = 0;
function probeSelection() {
  const a = ta.selectionStart, b = ta.selectionEnd, text = ta.value.slice(a, b).trim();
  probe = null;

  const file = game ? game.file : lastProgram; if (!file) return;
  const names = new Map();
  for (const k of file.fieldNames()) if (!["update", "draw"].includes(k)) { try { names.set(k, file.field(k)); } catch (e) {} }
  if (game) names.set("game", game.state);

});

window.EditorTools = { openSheet, closeSheet, browseTo, backToNow, get versions() { return versions; }, runCode, get probe() { return probe; }, literalAt, openCtl, closeCtl, showValues, valueLines, openMenu, LINE_ACTIONS, set values(on) { valsOn = on; LS.set("sprout3.values", on); showValues(); }, undo, redo, suggestions, keysUI, fontSize, get undoDepth() { return UNDO.length; } };
UNDO.push({ code, sel: [0, 0] });

})();
````

## libs.js

Wrapped libraries (decision 106): chroma, simplex, mathjs, date-fns, fuse, nlp, tone and turf as Sprout modules, loaded from vendor/ when a program names them

````js
// Popular JavaScript libraries, wrapped as Sprout modules (decision 106). Each module is a global cell of words, like the
// standard library's, and its library is loaded only when a program names it: from vendor/ on the page (play.html waits
// for it before running), and straight from the same files in Node. Values cross over both ways: lists and arrays,
// records and objects, Sprout colours and hex text, Sprout dates and JavaScript dates.
(function (root) {
"use strict";
const S = root.Sprout3 || (typeof module !== "undefined" ? require("./sprout3.js") : null);
const I = S.internals, W = S.words;
const { list, record, argumentsOf } = W;
const inNode = typeof window === "undefined";

// ===================================================================== values across the border
function toJS(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof v !== "object") return v;
  if (W.Colour && v instanceof W.Colour) return v.sproutText();
  if (W.SproutDate && v instanceof W.SproutDate) { const [y, m, d] = v.parts(); return new Date(y, m - 1, d, 12); }
  if (W.Pair && v instanceof W.Pair) return [v.x, v.y];
  if (W.Word && v instanceof W.Word) return v.name;
  if (I.isCell(v)) {
    const keys = v.fieldNames(), parts = I.partsOf(v);
    if (keys.length && !parts.length) { const o = {}; for (const k of keys) o[k] = toJS(v.field(k)); return o; }
    return parts.map(toJS);
  }
  return typeof v.sproutText === "function" ? v.sproutText() : String(v);
}
function fromJS(x) {
  if (x === null || x === undefined) return false;
  if (typeof x === "number" || typeof x === "string" || typeof x === "boolean") return x;
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return list(x.map(fromJS));
  if (x instanceof Date) return isNaN(x) ? false : S.globals.date.fn(list([x.getFullYear(), x.getMonth() + 1, x.getDate()]));
  if (x && x.constructor === Object) { const keys = Object.keys(x); return record(keys, keys.map(k => fromJS(x[k]))); }
  if (x && typeof x.toArray === "function") return fromJS(x.toArray());     // a math.js matrix
  return String(x);
}
const colourOf = hex => S.globals.colour.fn(hex);
const args = (a, n) => argumentsOf(a, n).map(toJS);
const word = (name, fn, effect) => new I.Native(name, a => { try { return fn(a); } catch (e) { return I.logMiss(name + ": " + (e && e.message || e)); } }, effect);

// ===================================================================== the libraries
// for each: where its file is, the global it makes, and its words (each with what it does and an example)
const LIBRARIES = {
  chroma: {
    title: "chroma.js", file: "vendor/chroma/chroma.min.js", global: "chroma", licence: "BSD",
    about: "Colour scales, colour-blind-safe palettes, contrast for reading, and mixing that looks even to the eye.",
    words: lib => ({
      scale: ["a colour part of the way along a list of colours, mixed in Lab so the steps look even: [colours, t]", "chroma scale [[#fafa6e, #2a4858], 0.5]",
        a => { const [cs, t] = args(a, 2); return colourOf(lib.scale(cs).mode("lab")(t).hex()); }],
      steps: ["n colours evenly along a list of colours: [colours, n]", "chroma steps [[#fafa6e, #2a4858], 4]",
        a => { const [cs, n] = args(a, 2); return list(lib.scale(cs).mode("lab").colors(n).map(colourOf)); }],
      brewer: ["n colours from a ColorBrewer palette by name, such as Viridis, YlGnBu, Spectral or Set2: [name, n]", 'chroma brewer ["Viridis", 5]',
        a => { const [name, n] = args(a, 2); return list(lib.scale(name).colors(n).map(colourOf)); }],
      contrast: ["the WCAG contrast between two colours: 4.5 or more is easy to read", "chroma contrast [#ffffff, #5fa8d3]",
        a => { const [x, y] = args(a, 2); return +lib.contrast(x, y).toFixed(2); }],
      readable: ["black or white, whichever reads better on a colour", "chroma readable #5fa8d3",

      mix: ["two colours mixed in Lab: [a, b, t]", "chroma mix [#ff0000, #0000ff, 0.5]",

      named: ["a colour by its CSS name", 'chroma named "tomato"', a => colourOf(lib(toJS(a)).hex())],
      temperature: ["the colour of light at a temperature in kelvin", "chroma temperature 3500", a => colourOf(lib.temperature(toJS(a)).hex())],
      darken: ["a colour darker by an amount (1 is a lot)", "chroma darken [#5fa8d3, 1]", a => { const [c, k] = args(a, 2); return colourOf(lib(c).darken(k).hex()); }],
      brighten: ["a colour brighter by an amount", "chroma brighten [#1f6f8b, 1]", a => { const [c, k] = args(a, 2); return colourOf(lib(c).brighten(k).hex()); }],
      saturate: ["a colour more saturated by an amount", "chroma saturate [#9a978d, 2]", a => { const [c, k] = args(a, 2); return colourOf(lib(c).saturate(k).hex()); }],
      luminance: ["how bright a colour is to the eye, from 0 to 1", "chroma luminance #5fa8d3", a => +lib(toJS(a)).luminance().toFixed(3)],
    }),

  simplex: {
    title: "simplex-noise", file: "vendor/simplex/simplex-noise.js", global: "SimplexNoise", licence: "MIT",

    words: lib => {
      const Noise = lib.SimplexNoise || lib, cache = new Map();

        noise3: ["smooth noise at x, y, z (z is often time, for noise that moves)", "simplex noise3 [0.5, 1.25, 2]", a => { const [x, y, z] = args(a, 3); return gen("sprout").noise3D(x, y, z); }],
        fractal: ["noise in several layers, big shapes with small detail on top: [x, y, layers]", "simplex fractal [0.5, 1.25, 4]", a => { const [x, y, o] = args(a, 3); return fractal(gen("sprout"), x, y, o || 4); }],
        seeded: ["noise from its own seed, for a different world: [seed, x, y]", "simplex seeded [7, 0.5, 1.25]", a => { const [s, x, y] = args(a, 3); return gen(s).noise2D(x, y); }],
      };
    },
  },
  mathjs: {

        convert: ["an amount in another unit, as a number: [amount, unit]", 'mathjs convert ["60 mi/h", "km/h"]', a => { const [v, u] = args(a, 2); return +lib.unit(v).toNumber(u).toFixed(10); }],
        fraction: ["exact fractions, as text", 'mathjs fraction "1/3 + 1/6"', a => { const tree = lib.parse(toJS(a)).transform(n => n.isConstantNode && typeof n.value === "number" ? new lib.ConstantNode(lib.fraction(n.value)) : n); return lib.format(tree.evaluate(), { fraction: "ratio" }); }],
        solve: ["x for a set of linear equations A x = b: [A, b]", "mathjs solve [[[2, 1], [1, 3]], [3, 5]]", a => { const [A, b] = args(a, 2); return fromJS(lib.lusolve(A, b).map(r => +r[0].toFixed(10))); }],
        multiply: ["two matrices (or a matrix and a vector) multiplied", "mathjs multiply [[[1, 2], [3, 4]], [5, 6]]", a => { const [x, y] = args(a, 2); return out(lib.multiply(x, y)); }],
        inverse: ["the inverse of a square matrix", "mathjs inverse [[4, 7], [2, 6]]", a => fromJS(lib.inv(toJS(a)).map(r => r.map(v => +v.toFixed(10))))],
        determinant: ["the determinant of a square matrix", "mathjs determinant [[4, 7], [2, 6]]", a => +lib.det(toJS(a)).toFixed(10)],
        derivative: ["the derivative of an expression, as text: [expression, variable]", 'mathjs derivative ["x^3 + 2x", "x"]', a => { const [e, v] = args(a, 2); return lib.derivative(e, v).toString(); }],
````

## examples/terrain.sp

Terrain: a map from simplex noise coloured by chroma scales, flying east (Tools group)

````sprout
-- Terrain: a map made of smooth noise (the simplex module) and coloured by scales (the chroma module),
-- flying slowly east. Change the sea level, the layers, the zoom or the colours while it flies.

cell : 12                 -- the size of one square, in pixels
zoom : 0.004              -- smaller is a wider view
layers : 4                -- more layers, more small detail
sea : 0.05                -- heights below this are water
speed : 30                -- how fast it flies, in pixels a second
land : chroma steps [[#2f6b2f, #8fbf5a, #d8c88a, #8a6d4b, #ffffff], 16]
water : chroma steps [[#0b2545, #1f6f8b, #6fc3d9], 8]

-- the colour for a height from -1 to 1
shade : [h |
  h < sea [water @ (clamp [h + 1 / (sea + 1) * 8 ceil, 1, 8])] else [land @ (clamp [h - sea / (1 - sea) * 16 ceil, 1, 16])]
]

start :
  flown : 0

update : [game | game with [flown : game flown + (speed * (game dt))]]

draw : [game |
  clear "#0b2545"
  range (H / cell ceil) each [row |
    range (W / cell ceil) each [column |
      x : column - 1 * cell
      y : row - 1 * cell
      rect [x, y, cell, cell, shade (simplex fractal [x + (game flown) * zoom, y * zoom, layers])]
    ]
  ]
  text ["simplex + chroma", W / 2, H - 14, 12, "#ffffffaa"]
]
````

## net.js

Two players, no server (decision 107): WebRTC with invite and reply links sent by text, lockstep with seeded random numbers, state fingerprints and resync, shared live coding

````js
// Two players, no server (decision 107). Two browsers connect straight to each other with WebRTC. The details each needs
// to find the other travel as links sent by text message: an invite one way, a reply the other.
// Then the game runs in lockstep: each screen sends only its touches and keys, both run the same Sprout game frame by
// frame (a few frames behind, to hide the trip), and a seeded random source keeps their luck the same. Now and then
// they compare the state; if it ever differs, the inviter's state is sent across and both carry on from it.
// Code edits travel too, and both screens swap them in on the same frame, so two people can live-code one game.
(function () {
"use strict";
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const ICE = [{ urls: "stun:stun.l.google.com:19302" }];
const STEP = 1 / 60, DELAY = 4, HASH_EVERY = 120;

// ===================================================================== invite and reply links
const b64 = bytes => { let s = ""; for (const b of bytes) s += String.fromCharCode(b); return btoa(s).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, ""); };
const unb64 = s => { const t = atob(s.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/")); return Uint8Array.from(t, c => c.charCodeAt(0)); };
async function pack(obj) {
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(obj));
  if (window.CompressionStream) { const out = await new Response(new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream("deflate-raw"))).arrayBuffer(); return "z" + b64(new Uint8Array(out)); }
  return "j" + b64(bytes);
}
async function unpack(s) {
  let bytes = unb64(s.slice(1));
  if (s[0] === "z") bytes = new Uint8Array(await new Response(new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("deflate-raw"))).arrayBuffer());
  return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));
}
const pageUrl = () => location.origin + location.pathname;
function iceDone(pc, ms) { return new Promise(ok => { if (pc.iceGatheringState === "complete") return ok(); const t = setTimeout(ok, ms || 3000); pc.addEventListener("icegatheringstatechange", () => { if (pc.iceGatheringState === "complete") { clearTimeout(t); ok(); } }); }); }

// ===================================================================== values across the wire, exactly
function toWire(v) {
  if (v === null || typeof v !== "object") return typeof v === "number" && !Number.isFinite(v) ? { n: String(v) } : v;
  if (v instanceof S.Cell && v.takesInput()) return { c: S.words.sourceOf(v) };
  if (S.isCell(v)) { const f = {}; for (const k of v.fieldNames()) f[k] = toWire(v.field(k)); return { f, p: S.partsOf(v).map(toWire) }; }
  if (v.kind && typeof v.sproutText === "function") return { k: v.kind, t: S.words.sourceOf(v) };
  return String(v);
}
function fromWire(x) {
  if (x === null || typeof x !== "object") return x;
  if (x.n) return Number(x.n);
  if (x.c) return S.globals.eval.fn(x.c);
  if (x.k) return S.words.literal(x.k, x.t, 0);
  return S.valueCellOf(x.p.map(fromWire), new Map(Object.entries(x.f).map(([k, v]) => [k, fromWire(v)])));
}
const fnv = t => { let h = 2166136261; for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) h = Math.imul(h ^ t.charCodeAt(i), 16777619); return h >>> 0; };
const seeded = seed => () => { seed |= 0; seed = seed + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ seed >>> 15, 1 | seed); t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t; return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };

// ===================================================================== the connection
const NET = window.NET = {
  active: false, me: 1, seed: 0, frame: 0, pc: null, dc: null, id: "", acc: 0, waiting: false,
  inputs: { 1: new Map(), 2: new Map() }, past: new Map(), queue: [], codeAt: new Map(), hashes: new Map(), theirs: new Map(), applying: false,
  gameOptions() { return this.active ? { players: 2, me: this.me, random: this.random } : {}; },
};
// the page can set its own wording (window.NET_TEXT): SilverEye's invite says SilverEye, not Sprout
const T = Object.assign({ invite: "Play my Sprout game with me:", reply: "Here's my reply, tap it to start:", game: "this game" }, window.NET_TEXT || {});
// a big message (a game's whole code) goes in pieces: Safari won't send one over about 64 KB
const PIECE = 12000;
function send(msg) {
  if (!NET.dc || NET.dc.readyState !== "open") return;
  const text = JSON.stringify(msg);
  if (text.length <= PIECE) { NET.dc.send(text); return; }
  const id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8), n = Math.ceil(text.length / PIECE);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) NET.dc.send(JSON.stringify({ t: "piece", id, i, n, d: text.slice(i * PIECE, (i + 1) * PIECE) }));
}
const pieces = new Map();
function gotPiece(m) {
  const p = pieces.get(m.id) || { n: m.n, parts: [] }; pieces.set(m.id, p); p.parts[m.i] = m.d;
  if (p.parts.filter(x => x !== undefined).length === p.n) { pieces.delete(m.id); receive(JSON.parse(p.parts.join(""))); }
}
function wire(dc) {
  NET.dc = dc;
  dc.onopen = () => { if (NET.me === 1) { const seed = (Math.random() * 2 ** 31) | 0; send({ t: "start", seed, src: code }); begin(seed, code); } };
  dc.onmessage = e => { const m = JSON.parse(e.data); if (m.t === "piece") gotPiece(m); else receive(m); };
  dc.onclose = () => { if (NET.active) { NET.active = false; toast("Your friend left. You're playing alone now."); netUI(); restartAlone(); } };
}
function newPeer() {
  const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: ICE });
  pc.onconnectionstatechange = () => { if (pc.connectionState === "failed") { boxStatus("The phones couldn't reach each other. On the same Wi-Fi it works best; some mobile networks block direct connections."); } };
  return pc;
}
// the inviter: an offer, waiting for a reply
async function invite() {
  if (NET.pc) NET.pc.close();
  NET.me = 1; NET.id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10); NET.replied = false;
  const pc = NET.pc = newPeer(); wire(pc.createDataChannel("sprout", { ordered: true }));
  await pc.setLocalDescription(await pc.createOffer()); await iceDone(pc);
  // a short link: the game's code goes over the connection once it opens (a long link breaks in some messaging apps)
  return pageUrl() + "#join=" + await pack({ v: 1, id: NET.id, sdp: pc.localDescription.sdp, src: code.length < 3000 ? code : undefined, ex: curEx });
}
async function acceptReply(text) {
  const m = /#?answer=([\w-]+)/.exec(text || ""); if (!m || !NET.pc) return false;
  // a reply can reach this tab more than once (a message from another tab, and storage): take it only once
  if (NET.replied || NET.pc.signalingState !== "have-local-offer") return true;
  NET.replied = true;   // set at once: two copies can arrive together, before the first has finished
  try { localStorage.removeItem("sprout-net-answer"); } catch (e) {}
  const a = await unpack(m[1]).catch(() => null); if (!a || a.id !== NET.id) { NET.replied = false; boxStatus("That reply is for a different invite."); return false; }
  await NET.pc.setRemoteDescription({ type: "answer", sdp: a.sdp }); boxStatus("Connecting…"); return true;
}
// the friend: a reply to an invite
async function reply(offer) {
  if (NET.pc) NET.pc.close();
  NET.me = 2; NET.id = offer.id;
  const pc = NET.pc = newPeer(); pc.ondatachannel = e => wire(e.channel);
  await pc.setRemoteDescription({ type: "offer", sdp: offer.sdp });
  await pc.setLocalDescription(await pc.createAnswer()); await iceDone(pc);
  return pageUrl() + "#answer=" + await pack({ v: 1, id: offer.id, sdp: pc.localDescription.sdp });
}

// ===================================================================== lockstep
function begin(seed, src) {
  NET.seed = seed; NET.random = seeded(seed); NET.active = true; NET.frame = 0; NET.acc = 0;
  NET.inputs = { 1: new Map(), 2: new Map() }; NET.queue = []; NET.codeAt = new Map(); NET.hashes = new Map(); NET.theirs = new Map(); NET.checks = 0; NET.mismatches = 0; NET.past = new Map();
  for (let f = 0; f < DELAY; f++) { NET.inputs[1].set(f, { ev: [], held: [] }); NET.inputs[2].set(f, { ev: [], held: [] }); }
  if (src !== code) setCode(src);
  NET.applying = true; try { build(src, true); } finally { NET.applying = false; }
  setPaused(false); closeBox(); netUI();
  toast("Connected. You're player " + NET.me + (NET.me === 1 ? " (the first)" : " (the second)") + ".");
}
NET.input = ev => { NET.queue.push(ev); };
// held keys go across as names; a held value that isn't just true (a stick's tilt, say) goes as [name, value]
const heldOf = keys => S.valueCellOf([], new Map(keys.map(k => Array.isArray(k) ? k : [k, true])));
const heldList = held => held.fieldNames().map(k => { const v = held.field(k); return v === true ? k : [k, v]; });
NET.advance = function (dt, held) {
  if (!game) return;
  NET.acc = Math.min(NET.acc + dt, 0.25);
  let steps = 0;
  while (NET.acc >= STEP && steps < 4) {
    // this screen's input for a few frames ahead goes to both
    const ahead = NET.frame + DELAY, mine = NET.inputs[NET.me];
    if (!mine.has(ahead)) { const msg = { ev: NET.queue.splice(0), held: heldList(held) }; mine.set(ahead, msg); send({ t: "in", f: ahead, ...msg }); }
    const a = NET.inputs[1].get(NET.frame), b = NET.inputs[2].get(NET.frame);
    if (!a || !b) { NET.waiting = true; break; }
    NET.waiting = false;
    const src = NET.codeAt.get(NET.frame);
    if (src !== undefined) { NET.codeAt.delete(NET.frame); applyCode(src); }
    for (const [who, input] of [[1, a], [2, b]]) for (const e of input.ev) {
      const p = who === 2 ? 2 : undefined;
      if (e.kind === "down") game.down(e.x, e.y, p); else if (e.kind === "move") game.move(e.x, e.y, p); else game.up(p);

    game.tick(STEP, heldOf(a.held), heldOf(b.held));

    NET.past.set(NET.frame, { 1: a, 2: b }); NET.past.delete(NET.frame - 150);

    NET.frame++; NET.acc -= STEP; steps++;
    if (NET.frame % HASH_EVERY === 0) { const h = fnv(S.format(game.state)); NET.hashes.set(NET.frame, h); send({ t: "hash", f: NET.frame, h }); compare(NET.frame); }

};
// both fingerprints of a frame, compared when the second arrives; if the states differ (floating point can differ
// between browsers), the inviter's state wins
function compare(f) {
  const mine = NET.hashes.get(f), theirs = NET.theirs.get(f);
  if (mine === undefined || theirs === undefined) return;
  NET.hashes.delete(f); NET.theirs.delete(f); NET.checks = (NET.checks || 0) + 1;
  if (mine !== theirs) { NET.mismatches = (NET.mismatches || 0) + 1; if (NET.me === 1) send({ t: "state", f: NET.frame, clock: game.clock, state: toWire(game.state) }); }
}
function receive(m) {
  if (m.t === "start") begin(m.seed, m.src);
  else if (m.t === "in") NET.inputs[NET.me === 1 ? 2 : 1].set(m.f, { ev: m.ev, held: m.held });
  else if (m.t === "code") { NET.codeAt.set(m.f, m.src); }
  else if (m.t === "hash") { NET.theirs.set(m.f, m.h); compare(m.f); }
  else if (m.t === "state" && NET.me === 2) {
    game.setState(fromWire(m.state), m.clock);
    for (const k of [...NET.inputs[1].keys()]) if (k < m.f) NET.inputs[1].delete(k);
    for (const k of [...NET.inputs[2].keys()]) if (k < m.f) NET.inputs[2].delete(k);
    // this screen may already be past m.f: put back the inputs it used for those frames, so they can run again
    for (let f = m.f; f < NET.frame; f++) { const used = NET.past.get(f); if (used) { if (!NET.inputs[1].has(f)) NET.inputs[1].set(f, used[1]); if (!NET.inputs[2].has(f)) NET.inputs[2].set(f, used[2]); } }
    NET.frame = m.f; NET.resyncs = (NET.resyncs || 0) + 1;
    // the frames just ahead of the jump need this screen's input too, or both screens would wait for it forever:
    // send an empty one for each that's missing (the inviter already has its own for them)
    for (let f = m.f; f < m.f + DELAY; f++) if (!NET.inputs[NET.me].has(f)) { const msg = { ev: [], held: [] }; NET.inputs[NET.me].set(f, msg); send({ t: "in", f, ...msg }); }
  }
}
// an edit goes to both screens and is swapped in on the same frame
function applyCode(src) {
  NET.applying = true;
  try { if (src !== code && document.activeElement !== ta) setCode(src); build(src, false); } finally { NET.applying = false; }
}
const baseBuild = window.build;
window.build = function (src, fresh) {
  if (!NET.active || NET.applying || !game || fresh) return baseBuild(src, fresh);
  if (src === running) return true;
  try { S.load(src); } catch (e) { setErr({ line: lineOf(e), msg: msgOf(e) }); return false; }
  const f = NET.frame + DELAY; NET.codeAt.set(f, src); send({ t: "code", f, src }); setErr(null);
  return true;
};
function restartAlone() { NET.applying = true; try { build(code, true); } finally { NET.applying = false; } }

// ===================================================================== the box that walks through it
const css = document.createElement("style");
css.textContent = `
#netBox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);padding:16px}
#netBox.on{display:flex}
#netBox .in{width:min(420px,100%);background:var(--card);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 18px 16px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.3);font:500 15px/1.45 var(--sans);color:var(--fg)}
#netBox h3{margin:0 0 6px;font:600 19px var(--serif, var(--sans))}
#netBox p{margin:6px 0 10px;color:var(--fg2)}
#netBox .st{font-size:13px;color:var(--fg3);min-height:18px}
#netBox .row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0 4px}
#netBox button{height:40px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:999px;font:600 14px var(--sans);background:var(--card2);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line);color:var(--fg)}
#netBox button.pri{background:var(--acc);color:#fff;box-shadow:none}
#netBox textarea{width:100%;height:64px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card2);color:var(--fg);font:12px var(--mono);padding:8px;resize:none}
#netBadge{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:4;display:none;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:#fff;font:600 11px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.03em}
body.net #netBadge{display:block}
`;
document.head.appendChild(css);
const box = document.createElement("div"); box.id = "netBox"; box.innerHTML = '<div class="in"></div>'; document.body.appendChild(box);
const badge = document.createElement("div"); badge.id = "netBadge"; $("stage").appendChild(badge);
const inner = () => box.firstChild;
function openBox(html) { inner().innerHTML = html; box.classList.add("on"); }
function closeBox() { box.classList.remove("on"); }
function boxStatus(t) { const s = box.querySelector(".st"); if (s) s.textContent = t; else toast(t); }
box.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { if (e.target === box) closeBox(); });
async function shareLink(link, text) {
  const message = text + " " + link;
  if (navigator.share) { try { await navigator.share({ text: message }); return "shared"; } catch (e) { if (e && e.name === "AbortError") return "cancelled"; } }
  try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(message); toast("Copied. Paste it into a message."); return "copied"; } catch (e) { prompt("Copy this and send it:", message); return "shown"; }
}
function netUI() {
  document.body.classList.toggle("net", NET.active);
  badge.textContent = NET.active ? "Player " + NET.me + (NET.waiting ? " · waiting" : " · two players") : "";
}

// the inviter's box
async function openInvite() {
  openBox(`<h3>Play ${T.game} with a friend</h3><p>1. Send your friend the invite. 2. They tap Join and send you a reply. 3. Tap their reply (or Paste reply here) and you're in. No server: the two phones talk straight to each other.</p>
    <div class="st">Making your invite…</div><div class="row"><button class="pri" id="nSend" disabled>Send invite</button><button id="nCopy" disabled>Copy</button></div>
    <p style="margin-top:14px">Got their reply? Tap its link, or copy it and:</p>
    <div class="row"><button class="pri" id="nPasteBtn">Paste reply</button><button id="nClose">Close</button></div>
    <textarea id="nPaste" placeholder="…or paste the reply here"></textarea><div class="row"><button id="nUse">Use reply</button></div>`);
  $("nClose").onclick = closeBox;
  let link;
  try { link = await invite(); } catch (e) { boxStatus("This browser can't make a direct connection (" + (e.message || e) + ")."); return; }
  boxStatus("Your invite is ready. Keep this open (or come back to it) for their reply.");
  $("nSend").disabled = $("nCopy").disabled = false;
  $("nSend").onclick = async () => { const how = await shareLink(link, T.invite); if (how !== "cancelled") boxStatus("Invite sent. When their reply comes, tap it, or copy it and tap Paste reply."); };
  $("nCopy").onclick = async () => { try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(link); toast("Invite copied"); } catch (e) { prompt("Copy this:", link); } };
  $("nPasteBtn").onclick = async () => {
    let text = ""; try { text = await navigator.clipboard.readText(); } catch (e) { boxStatus("Couldn't read the clipboard here: paste the reply into the box below."); $("nPaste").focus(); return; }
    if (!await acceptReply(text)) boxStatus("That isn't a reply link: copy the whole message your friend sent, then tap Paste reply.");
  };
  $("nUse").onclick = async () => { if (!await acceptReply($("nPaste").value)) boxStatus("That doesn't look like a reply link."); };
  $("nPaste").oninput = async () => { if (/answer=/.test($("nPaste").value)) await acceptReply($("nPaste").value); };
}
// a reply opened in another tab is left in this browser's storage; the tab that made the invite takes it as soon as it
// runs again (a tab in the background is often asleep, so a message to it can be missed)
const ANSWER_KEY = "sprout-net-answer";
async function takeStoredAnswer() {
  if (!NET.pc || NET.me !== 1 || NET.active) return;
  let a = null; try { a = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ANSWER_KEY) || "null"); } catch (e) {}
  if (!a || a.id !== NET.id) return;
  try { localStorage.removeItem(ANSWER_KEY); } catch (e) {}
  await acceptReply("#answer=" + a.blob);
}
addEventListener("storage", e => { if (e.key === ANSWER_KEY) takeStoredAnswer(); });
addEventListener("focus", takeStoredAnswer);
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => { if (!document.hidden) takeStoredAnswer(); });
setInterval(takeStoredAnswer, 1500);
// a reply opened in another tab is handed to the tab that made the invite
const channel = window.BroadcastChannel ? new BroadcastChannel("sprout-net") : null;
if (channel) channel.onmessage = async e => {
  const m = e.data || {};
  if (m.t === "answer" && NET.pc && m.id === NET.id && NET.me === 1) { await acceptReply("#answer=" + m.blob); channel.postMessage({ t: "taken", id: m.id }); }
};
async function handleHash() {
  const join = /^#join=([\w-]+)/.exec(location.hash), answer = /^#answer=([\w-]+)/.exec(location.hash);
  if (!join && !answer) return;
  history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname);
  if (answer) {
    // this tab made the invite itself: take it here
    if (NET.pc && NET.me === 1) { await acceptReply("#answer=" + answer[1]); return; }
    const a = await unpack(answer[1]).catch(() => null);
    if (a) try { localStorage.setItem(ANSWER_KEY, JSON.stringify({ id: a.id, blob: answer[1], at: Date.now() })); } catch (e) {}
    openBox(`<h3>Reply received</h3><p>Now switch back to the tab where you sent the invite: it connects by itself as soon as it's open.</p>
      <p>Playing from your home screen? Tap Copy, open the game and tap Paste reply.</p><div class="st"></div>
      <div class="row"><button class="pri" id="nCopyReply">Copy</button><button id="nClose">Close</button></div>`);
    $("nClose").onclick = closeBox;
    $("nCopyReply").onclick = async () => { try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(location.origin + location.pathname + "#answer=" + answer[1]); toast("Reply copied"); } catch (e) { prompt("Copy this:", location.origin + location.pathname + "#answer=" + answer[1]); } };
    if (!a) { boxStatus("That reply link is broken."); return; }
    if (channel) {
      channel.onmessage = e => { if (e.data && e.data.t === "taken" && e.data.id === a.id) boxStatus("Done: your game took it. Go back to that tab."); };
      channel.postMessage({ t: "answer", id: a.id, blob: answer[1] });
    }
    return;
  }
  const offer = await unpack(join[1]).catch(() => null);
  if (!offer) { toast("That invite link is broken"); return; }
  if (offer.src) { curEx = offer.ex || ""; dirty = true; setCode(offer.src); build(offer.src, true); }
  openBox(`<h3>You're invited</h3><p>A friend wants to play ${T.game} with you. Tap Join, send them the reply, then come back here: the game starts when they tap it.</p>
    <div class="st"></div><div class="row"><button class="pri" id="nJoin">Join</button><button id="nClose">Not now</button></div>`);
  $("nClose").onclick = closeBox;
  $("nJoin").onclick = async () => {
    boxStatus("Making your reply…"); $("nJoin").disabled = true;
    let link; try { link = await reply(offer); } catch (e) { boxStatus("This browser can't make a direct connection (" + (e.message || e) + ")."); return; }
    inner().querySelector(".row").innerHTML = '<button class="pri" id="nSend">Send reply</button><button id="nCopy">Copy</button><button id="nClose2">Close</button>';
    boxStatus("Send this back to your friend, then come back here: the game starts by itself when they tap it.");
    $("nSend").onclick = () => shareLink(link, T.reply);
    $("nCopy").onclick = async () => { try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(link); toast("Reply copied"); } catch (e) { prompt("Copy this:", link); } };
    $("nClose2").onclick = closeBox;
  };
}
addEventListener("hashchange", handleHash);
handleHash();

NET.invite = openInvite; NET.toWire = toWire; NET.fromWire = fromWire; NET.pack = pack; NET.unpack = unpack; NET.begin = begin; NET.receive = receive;
})();
````

## examples/volley.sp

Volley: the first game for two phones (Games group)

````sprout
-- Volley: a game for two phones. Press Two players (or More, then Play with a friend) and send the invite by text.
-- Each player drags their own paddle; each screen shows its player at the bottom. Alone, the top paddle plays itself.
-- Change the ball speed, the paddle size or the colours while you play: the change reaches both phones.

paddle-width : 80
paddle-y : 40              -- how far each paddle is from its own end
ball-speed : 260
speed-up : 1.04            -- the ball gets this much faster at each hit
mine : #e8a33d
theirs : #5fa8d3

start :
  ball : [x : 180, y : 240, vx : 120, vy : 220]
  near : 180               -- player 1's paddle, at the bottom of the court
  far : 180                -- player 2's paddle, at the top
  score : [near : 0, far : 0]

-- player 2 sees the court turned round, so their finger's x is flipped
update : [game |
  dt : game dt
  two-players : game has-field "input2"
  near-x : (game input touching) [game input touch-x] else [game near]
  far-x : cond [
    two-players and (game input2 touching), W - (game input2 touch-x)
    two-players, game far
    any, toward [game far, game ball x, 0.08]
  ]
  b : game ball
  moved : b with [x : b x + (b vx * dt), y : b y + (b vy * dt)]
  walls : (moved x < 8) or (moved x > (W - 8)) [moved with [vx : 0 - (moved vx)]] else [moved]
  hit-near : (walls vy > 0) and (walls y > (H - paddle-y - 8)) and ((walls x - near-x) abs < (paddle-width / 2))
  hit-far : (walls vy < 0) and (walls y < (paddle-y + 8)) and ((walls x - far-x) abs < (paddle-width / 2))
  bounced : cond [
    hit-near, walls with [vy : 0 - (walls vy) * speed-up, vx : walls x - near-x * 4]
    hit-far, walls with [vy : 0 - (walls vy) * speed-up, vx : walls x - far-x * 4]
    any, walls
  ]
  served : [towards | [x : W / 2, y : H / 2, vx : rand [-120, 120], vy : ball-speed * towards]]
  cond [
    bounced y > (H + 20), game with [near : near-x, far : far-x, ball : served -1, score : game score with [far : game score far + 1]]
    bounced y < -20, game with [near : near-x, far : far-x, ball : served 1, score : game score with [near : game score near + 1]]
    any, game with [near : near-x, far : far-x, ball : bounced]
  ]
]

-- each screen draws its own player at the bottom
flip : [y | me = 2 [H - y] else [y]]
flip-x : [x | me = 2 [W - x] else [x]]
draw : [game |
  clear "#101318"
  line [0, H / 2, W, H / 2, "#2a2f38"]
  rect [flip-x (game near) - (paddle-width / 2), flip (H - paddle-y) - 5, paddle-width, 10, me = 1 [mine] else [theirs]]
  rect [flip-x (game far) - (paddle-width / 2), flip paddle-y - 5, paddle-width, 10, me = 1 [theirs] else [mine]]
  circle [flip-x (game ball x), flip (game ball y), 8, "#f4f1ea"]
  mine-score : me = 1 [game score near] else [game score far]
  their-score : me = 1 [game score far] else [game score near]
  text ["[their-score]", W / 2, H / 2 - 30, 28, "#5a6270"]
  text ["[mine-score]", W / 2, H / 2 + 50, 28, "#f4f1ea"]
]
````

## examples/silvereye-2d.sp

Bunker: a first-person raycaster in an underground lab, with guards and proximity mines (Games group)

````sprout
-- SilverEye 2D: sneak through an underground lab, take down the guards, and use proximity mines.
-- A mine arms after a moment and goes off when anyone comes near it, you included.
-- Phone: drag to walk and turn, tap to fire, tap MINE to drop a mine. Keys: arrows or WASD, space to fire, M for a mine.
-- The view is a raycaster: one ray per column finds the nearest wall, and nearer walls are drawn taller.

level : [
  "################"
  "#......#.......#"
  "#......#.......#"
  "#..##..#..###..#"
  "#..##.....#....#"
  "#......#..#....#"
  "####.###..#.####"
  "#......#.......#"
  "#......#.......#"
  "#.###..####..###"
  "#...#..........#"
  "#...#..#####...#"
  "#......#...#...#"
  "#..........#...#"
  "#......#.......#"
  "################"
]
fov : 1.05                 -- how wide you see, in radians
columns : 72               -- rays across the screen: more is sharper and slower
walk-speed : 2.6
turn-speed : 2.4
mine-arm : 1.2             -- seconds before a dropped mine is live
mine-reach : 1.0           -- how close someone must come to set it off
blast : 2.1                -- how far the blast reaches
wall-colour : [208, 214, 196]
floor-colour : "#2b2c27"
ceiling-colour : "#1b1d22"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- the map
solid : [cx cy |
  row : level @ (cy floor + 1)
  cond [row = false, true, any, row @ (cx floor + 1) = "#"]
]
wall-cells : level numbered collect-flat [[r, row] | row chars numbered keep [[c, ch] | ch = "#"] collect [[c, ch] | [c, r]]]
-- is the way from a to b clear of walls?
clear-line : [ax ay bx by |
  steps : (bx - ax * (bx - ax) + (by - ay * (by - ay)) sqrt * 4 ceil) max 1
  range steps all [k | t : k / steps, (solid [bx - ax * t + ax, by - ay * t + ay]) not]
]
wrap : [a | cond [a > pi, a - (2 * pi), a < (0 - pi), a + (2 * pi), any, a]]

-- one ray from ox, oy at an angle: how far to the wall, and which face it hit (DDA, grid cell by grid cell)
cast : [ox oy angle |
  dx : angle cos
  dy : angle sin
  step-x : cond [dx < 0, -1, any, 1]
  step-y : cond [dy < 0, -1, any, 1]
  across : cond [dx = 0, 1000000, any, 1 / dx abs]
  along : cond [dy = 0, 1000000, any, 1 / dy abs]
  cell-x : ox floor
  cell-y : oy floor
  march : [mx my sx sy n |
    cond [
      n > 40, [far : 30, side : 0]
      sx < sy, (
        nx : mx + step-x
        solid [nx, my] [[far : sx, side : 0]] else [march [nx, my, sx + across, sy, n + 1]]
      )
      any, (
        ny : my + step-y
        solid [mx, ny] [[far : sy, side : 1]] else [march [mx, ny, sx, sy + along, n + 1]]
      )
    ]
  ]
  march [cell-x, cell-y, cond [dx < 0, ox - cell-x * across, any, cell-x + 1 - ox * across], cond [dy < 0, oy - cell-y * along, any, cell-y + 1 - oy * along], 0]
]

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- the people
guard : [id gx gy tx ty | [id : id, x : gx, y : gy, angle : 0, health : 100, wait : 1, alert : false, home-x : gx, home-y : gy, to-x : tx, to-y : ty]]
start :
  hero : [x : 2.5, y : 2.5, angle : 0.6, health : 100]
  guards : [guard [1, 12.5, 2.5, 12.5, 4.5], guard [2, 3.5, 7.5, 6.5, 7.5], guard [3, 13.5, 7.5, 9.5, 7.5], guard [4, 2.5, 11.5, 2.5, 13.5], guard [5, 9.5, 12.5, 9.5, 12.5], guard [6, 13.5, 13.5, 13.5, 10.5]]
  mines : []
  blasts : []
  carried : 6
  drag : false
  fire-wait : 0
  mine-wait : 0
  flash : 0
  hurt : 0
  over : ""
  clock : 0
  dt : 0

-- move from (x, y) by (dx, dy), sliding along walls
slide : [x y dx dy |
  pad : 0.22
  nx : solid [x + dx + (cond [dx < 0, 0 - pad, any, pad]), y] [x] else [x + dx]
  ny : solid [nx, y + dy + (cond [dy < 0, 0 - pad, any, pad])] [y] else [y + dy]
  [x : nx, y : ny]
]
distance : [ax ay bx by | bx - ax * (bx - ax) + (by - ay * (by - ay)) sqrt]
near-mine-button : [tx ty | distance [tx, ty, W - 48, H - 48] < 40]

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- one frame
play : [game |
  dt : game dt
  now : game clock
  i : game input
  hero : game hero
  -- a finger: where it went down, and how far it has moved since
  finger : cond [i tapped, [x : i touch-x, y : i touch-y, at : now, last-x : i touch-x, last-y : i touch-y], i touching and (game drag != false), game drag with [last-x : i touch-x, last-y : i touch-y], any, game drag]
  released : (i touching not) and (game drag != false)
  quick-tap : released and (now - (game drag at) < 0.3) and ((game drag last-x - (game drag x)) abs < 14) and ((game drag last-y - (game drag y)) abs < 14)
  touch-turn : cond [i touching and (finger != false), clamp [finger last-x - (finger x) / 110, -1, 1], any, 0]
  touch-walk : cond [i touching and (finger != false) and (near-mine-button [finger x, finger y] not), clamp [finger y - (finger last-y) / 80, -1, 1], any, 0]
  key-turn : cond [(i held "left") or (i held "a"), -1, (i held "right") or (i held "d"), 1, any, 0]
  key-walk : cond [(i held "up") or (i held "w"), 1, (i held "down") or (i held "s"), -1, any, 0]
  turn : touch-turn + key-turn
  walk : touch-walk + key-walk
  wants-mine : (quick-tap and (near-mine-button [game drag x, game drag y])) or ((i held "m") and (game mine-wait <= 0))
  wants-fire : (quick-tap and (near-mine-button [game drag x, game drag y] not)) or ((i held "space") and (game fire-wait <= 0))
  -- walking and turning
  heading : hero angle + (turn * turn-speed * dt)
  step : walk * walk-speed * dt
  moved : slide [hero x, hero y, heading cos * step, heading sin * step]
  -- firing: the nearest live guard near the middle of the view, nearer than the wall
  centre-wall : cast [moved x, moved y, heading] far
  target : game guards keep [g | g health > 0] keep [g |
    gd : distance [moved x, moved y, g x, g y]
    rel : wrap (g y - (moved y) atan2 (g x - (moved x)) - heading)
    (rel abs < (0.05 + (0.22 / gd))) and (gd < centre-wall)
  ] smallest-by [g | distance [moved x, moved y, g x, g y]]
  shot : wants-fire and (target != false)
  wants-fire [beep [880, 0.04]]
  -- dropping a mine just ahead
  drop : wants-mine and (game carried > 0)
  drop [beep [440, 0.05]]
  mines : drop [game mines .. [[x : heading cos * 0.4 + (moved x), y : heading sin * 0.4 + (moved y), armed : now + mine-arm]]] else [game mines]
  -- guards: hit by the shot, then each one patrols, or turns on you once it sees you
  hit-guards : game guards collect [g | shot and (g id = (target id)) [g with [health : g health - 50, alert : true]] else [g]]
  thinking : hit-guards collect [g |
    g health <= 0 [g] else [
      gd : distance [g x, g y, moved x, moved y]
      facing : g y - (moved y) atan2 (g x - (moved x)) + pi
      looking : wrap (facing - (g angle)) abs < 0.9
      sees : (gd < 9) and ((g alert) or looking) and (clear-line [g x, g y, moved x, moved y])
      alert : (g alert) or sees
      goal-x : cond [alert, moved x, any, g to-x]
      goal-y : cond [alert, moved y, any, g to-y]
      gap : distance [g x, g y, goal-x, goal-y]
      pace : cond [alert and (gd < 3), 0, alert, 1.2, any, 0.8]
      head : goal-y - (g y) atan2 (goal-x - (g x))
      went : cond [gap < 0.05, [x : g x, y : g y], any, slide [g x, g y, head cos * pace * dt, head sin * pace * dt]]
      arrived : (alert not) and (gap < 0.3)
      fires : sees and (g wait <= 0)
      next-x : cond [arrived, g home-x, any, g to-x]
      next-y : cond [arrived, g home-y, any, g to-y]
      back-x : cond [arrived, g to-x, any, g home-x]
      back-y : cond [arrived, g to-y, any, g home-y]
      g with [
        x : went x, y : went y, angle : cond [alert, facing, any, head], alert : alert
        wait : cond [fires, 0.9, any, g wait - dt]
        to-x : next-x, to-y : next-y, home-x : back-x, home-y : back-y
        fired : fires, hits : fires and (noise [now * 7, g id] < (0.5 - (gd * 0.035)))
      ]
    ]
  ]
  pain : thinking count [g | g hits else false] * 9
  thinking any [g | g fired else false] [beep [180, 0.06]]
  -- mines: an armed mine goes off when anyone comes near
  armed : mines keep [m | now >= (m armed)]
  goes-off : armed keep [m | (thinking any [g | (g health > 0) and (distance [m x, m y, g x, g y] < mine-reach)]) or (distance [m x, m y, moved x, moved y] < (mine-reach * 0.7))]
  still : mines keep [m | (goes-off has m) not]
  (goes-off length > 0) [shake 10, beep [70, 0.4]]
  caught : [px py | goes-off collect [m | distance [m x, m y, px, py]] keep [d | d < blast]]
  guards : thinking collect [g | caught [g x, g y] length > 0 [g with [health : 0]] else [g]]
  blasted : caught [moved x, moved y] collect [d | blast - d * 60] sum
  life : hero health - pain - blasted
  blasts : game blasts keep [b | now - (b at) < 0.6] .. (goes-off collect [m | [x : m x, y : m y, at : now]])
  over : cond [life <= 0, "lost", guards all [g | g health <= 0], "won", any, ""]
  game with [
    hero : [x : moved x, y : moved y, angle : heading, health : life max 0]
    guards : guards, mines : still, blasts : blasts
    carried : drop [game carried - 1] else [game carried]
    drag : cond [released, false, any, finger]
    fire-wait : cond [wants-fire, 0.25, any, game fire-wait - dt]
    mine-wait : cond [wants-mine, 0.5, any, game mine-wait - dt]
    flash : cond [wants-fire, 0.08, any, game flash - dt]
    hurt : cond [pain + blasted > 0, 0.25, any, game hurt - dt]
    over : over
  ]
]

update : [game | game over = "" [play game] else [(game input tapped) [start] else [game]]]

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
shade : [rgb-list amount | rgb [rgb-list @ 1 * amount round, rgb-list @ 2 * amount round, rgb-list @ 3 * amount round]]

draw : [game |
  hero : game hero
  colw : W / columns
  clear ceiling-colour
  rect [0, H / 2, W, H / 2, floor-colour]
  -- the walls, one ray a column, the fisheye taken out
  rays : range columns collect [k |
    a : k - 0.5 / columns - 0.5 * fov + (hero angle)
    hit : cast [hero x, hero y, a]
    hit with [far : hit far * (a - (hero angle) cos)]
  ]
  rays numbered each [[k, r] |
    tall : H / (r far max 0.15) * 0.9
    light : 1 / (1 + (r far * 0.22)) * (cond [r side = 1, 0.72, any, 1])
    rect [k - 1 * colw, H / 2 - (tall / 2), colw + 1, tall, shade [wall-colour, light]]
  ]
  -- people, mines and blasts, far ones first, hidden behind nearer walls
  things : (game guards collect [g | g with [what : "guard"]]) .. (game mines collect [m | m with [what : "mine"]]) .. (game blasts collect [b | b with [what : "blast"]])
  placed : things collect [t |
    dx : t x - (hero x)
    dy : t y - (hero y)
    [t : t, d : (dx * dx + (dy * dy)) sqrt max 0.05, rel : wrap (dy atan2 dx - (hero angle))]
  ] keep [p | p rel abs < (fov / 2 + 0.3)] sort-by [p | 0 - (p d)]
  placed each [p |
    sx : p rel / fov + 0.5 * W
    col : clamp [sx / colw floor + 1, 1, columns]
    tall : H / (p d) * 0.9
    ground : H / 2 + (tall / 2)
    hidden : rays @ col far < (p d)
    t : p t
    hidden not [
      match [t what, [
        "guard", (
          dead : t health <= 0
          body : cond [t alert, "#a33b2f", any, "#4b5d73"]
          dead [rect [sx - (tall * 0.3), ground - (tall * 0.08), tall * 0.6, tall * 0.08, "#3a2a26"]]
          dead not [
            rect [sx - (tall * 0.12), ground - (tall * 0.42), tall * 0.24, tall * 0.42, "#2b3340"]
            rect [sx - (tall * 0.16), ground - (tall * 0.74), tall * 0.32, tall * 0.34, body]
            circle [sx, ground - (tall * 0.82), tall * 0.09, "#e0b48f"]
            rect [sx - (tall * 0.1), ground - (tall * 0.93), tall * 0.2, tall * 0.06, "#c33"]
          ]
        )
        "mine", (
          circle [sx, ground - (tall * 0.03), tall * 0.06 max 2, "#55585e"]
          (game clock >= (t armed)) and (game clock * 4 % 1 < 0.5) [circle [sx, ground - (tall * 0.06), tall * 0.02 max 1.5, "#ff3b30"]]
        )
        "blast", (
          age : game clock - (t at) / 0.6
          circle [sx, H / 2, tall * (0.3 + age), "#ffb347"]
          circle [sx, H / 2, tall * (0.15 + (age / 2)), "#fff3b0"]
        )
        any, false
      ]]
    ]
  ]
  -- the gun, the crosshair and the muzzle flash
  rect [W / 2 + 20, H - 70, 26, 70, "#3a3d42"]
  rect [W / 2 + 26, H - 96, 14, 30, "#55595f"]
  (game flash > 0) [circle [W / 2 + 33, H - 102, 14, "#ffd76a"]]
  line [W / 2 - 8, H / 2, W / 2 + 8, H / 2, "#ffffffaa"]
  line [W / 2, H / 2 - 8, W / 2, H / 2 + 8, "#ffffffaa"]
  -- the map in the corner
  wall-cells each [[c, r] | rect [c * 5 + 2, r * 5 + 2, 5, 5, "#4a4d45"]]
  game guards keep [g | g health > 0] each [g | circle [g x * 5 + 7, g y * 5 + 7, 1.6, "#ff5a4f"]]
  game mines each [m | circle [m x * 5 + 7, m y * 5 + 7, 1.4, "#ffd166"]]
  circle [hero x * 5 + 7, hero y * 5 + 7, 2, "#ffffff"]
  line [hero x * 5 + 7, hero y * 5 + 7, hero angle cos * 6 + (hero x * 5 + 7), hero angle sin * 6 + (hero y * 5 + 7), "#ffffff"]
  -- health, mines and the mine button
  rect [W - 112, 12, 100, 8, "#00000088"]
  rect [W - 112, 12, hero health, 8, cond [hero health > 35, "#7bd389", any, "#ff5a4f"]]
  text ["mines [game carried]", W - 62, 36, 12, "#f4f1ea"]
  circle [W - 48, H - 48, 34, "#00000066"]
  text ["MINE", W - 48, H - 44, 13, "#ffd166"]
  (game hurt > 0) [rect [0, 0, W, H, "#ff000040"]]
  (game clock < 5) and (game over = "") [text ["drag to walk · tap to fire · MINE drops a mine", W / 2, H - 140, 11, "#f4f1eacc"]]
  game over = "won" [rect [0, H / 2 - 50, W, 100, "#000000aa"], text ["LAB CLEARED", W / 2, H / 2 - 6, 24, "#7bd389"], text ["tap to go again", W / 2, H / 2 + 24, 12, "#f4f1ea"]]
  game over = "lost" [rect [0, H / 2 - 50, W, 100, "#000000aa"], text ["YOU WERE CAUGHT", W / 2, H / 2 - 6, 24, "#ff5a4f"], text ["tap to go again", W / 2, H / 2 + 24, 12, "#f4f1ea"]]
]
````

## three-view.js

The 3D view (decision 108): view, block, model, hold, flash and fog drawn with three.js, objects kept between frames, models posed by the game's clock

````js
// The 3D view (decision 108): a game's draw list may hold 3D words, and this draws them with three.js.
// Each frame the list is the whole scene, as with the 2D words: view (the camera), block (a box with a texture or a
// colour), model (a glTF model, posed by the game's own clock), hold (a model held in front of the camera), flash (a
// light with a glow) and fog. The scene objects are kept from frame to frame and reused, so a frame only moves them.
// Models are scaled to the height asked for and stood on the floor, whatever size they were made at.
import * as THREE from "./vendor/three/three.module.min.js";
import { GLTFLoader } from "./vendor/three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js";
import { MeshoptDecoder } from "./vendor/three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js";
import * as SkeletonUtils from "./vendor/three/addons/utils/SkeletonUtils.js";

const WORDS = new Set(["view", "block", "model", "hold", "flash", "fog", "light", "sky", "beam"]);
const fmt = v => typeof v === "string" ? v : window.Sprout3 ? Sprout3.format(v) : String(v);
const num = (v, d) => typeof v === "number" && isFinite(v) ? v : d;
// Sprout's angles: 0 looks along +x, and they turn towards +z. three.js cameras look down -z, models face +z.
const cameraYaw = a => -a - Math.PI / 2, modelYaw = a => Math.PI / 2 - a;

// opts.lowRes: draw this many pixels across and let the page stretch them, for a chunky old-console look
export function makeView(canvas, base, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: !opts.lowRes, alpha: false });
  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
  renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;

  renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping; renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.45;
  const scene = new THREE.Scene(), camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(70, 0.75, 0.05, 200);
  scene.add(camera);

  const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xdde6f5, 0x3a2e22, 1.25); scene.add(hemi);
  const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1dc, 1.35); sun.position.set(4, 10, 3); scene.add(sun);
  // light [sky colour, floor colour, key colour, strength]: each frame's lighting; without it, these defaults
  const LIGHT_DEFAULT = [0xdde6f5, 0x3a2e22, 0xfff1dc, 1];
  // the gun in your hands has its own scene and camera, drawn over the world: it sits the same in the corner however
  // wide the view is (a wide view would otherwise shrink it into the middle), lit by the same lights
  const holdScene = new THREE.Scene(), holdCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(62, 0.75, 0.01, 10);
  holdScene.add(holdCamera);
  const holdHemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xdde6f5, 0x3a2e22, 1.25), holdSun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1dc, 1.35);
  holdSun.position.set(-1.5, 2.5, 1.5); holdScene.add(holdHemi); holdScene.add(holdSun);
  // a flash close in front of you (your own shot) lights the gun in your hands as well as the room
  const holdFlash = new THREE.PointLight(0xffaa55, 0, 2.5, 2); holdFlash.position.set(0.1, -0.05, -0.85); holdScene.add(holdFlash);
  const holdGroup = new THREE.Group(); holdCamera.add(holdGroup);
  renderer.autoClear = false;
  const loader = new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);
  const textureLoader = new THREE.TextureLoader();

  // ---- assets: models and textures, loaded once, by name
  const assets = new Map();   // name -> { scene, clips, size, ready }
  function asset(name) {
    let a = assets.get(name);
    if (!a) {
      a = { ready: false };
      assets.set(name, a);
      loader.load(base + "vendor/models/" + name + ".glb", gltf => {
        const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(gltf.scene), size = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
        a.scene = gltf.scene; a.clips = gltf.animations; a.height = size.y || 1; a.longest = Math.max(size.x, size.y, size.z) || 1; a.floor = box.min.y; a.centre = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()); a.ready = true;
        gltf.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = false; o.frustumCulled = false; } });
      }, undefined, () => { a.failed = true; });

  dome.renderOrder = -1; dome.visible = false; scene.add(dome);

    const g = c.getContext("2d"), gr = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    gr.addColorStop(0, top); gr.addColorStop(0.3, top); gr.addColorStop(0.5, low); gr.addColorStop(1, low); g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  }

    if (/^glow:/.test(name)) { m = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(name.slice(5, 12)), toneMapped: false }); materials.set(key, m); return m; }
    if (isColour) m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(name.slice(0, 7)), roughness: 0.9 });
    else {

      // sharp (the full image, each texel a hard square) and soft (cut down to 64 by 64 and filtered smoothly, the
      // slightly blurred look of the late-90s consoles' small textures); setSoft switches every material between them
      m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8a8a86, roughness: 0.95 });
      m.userData.tex = name; m.userData.rep = [Math.max(sx, sz), sy];
      let t = textures.get(name);
      if (!t) {
        t = { image: null, soft: null, waiting: [] }; textures.set(name, t);
        textureLoader.load(base + "vendor/textures/" + name + ".png", tex => {
          tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter; tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
          const c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = c.height = 64; c.getContext("2d").drawImage(tex.image, 0, 0, 64, 64);
          const s = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); s.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; s.wrapS = s.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
          s.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter; s.minFilter = THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
          t.image = tex; t.soft = s; for (const f of t.waiting.splice(0)) f(t);
        });
      }
      const give = tt => { const r = (soft ? tt.soft : tt.image).clone(); r.repeat.set(m.userData.rep[0], m.userData.rep[1]); m.map = r; m.color.set(0xffffff); m.needsUpdate = true; };
      m.userData.give = give;

    materials.set(key, m); return m;
  }

  // ---- objects kept between frames
  const blocks = new Map(), unitBox = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
  const pools = new Map();   // model name -> [{ root, mixer, actions }]
  const holds = new Map();
  const flashes = [], glow = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 12);
  // beams: thin bright streaks between two points, a shot's tracer; a pool, reused frame to frame
  const beams = [], beamEnd = new THREE.Vector3();
  // blob shadows, as the old consoles did: a soft dark disc on the floor under everything that stands in the world
  const blobTexture = (() => { const c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = c.height = 64; const g = c.getContext("2d"), r = g.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 2, 32, 32, 31); r.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0.62)"); r.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)"); g.fillStyle = r; g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64); const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; return t; })();
  const blobGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), blobMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: blobTexture, transparent: true, depthWrite: false });
  // ---- people of our own: low-poly figures in a grown person's proportions, the way the late-90s shooters drew them,
  // built from boxes and posed by code. model ["rig:guard", x, 0, z, angle, 1.8, "walk", time, "gun"]: the dress is the
  // name after rig: (guard, soldier, elite, scientist, agent), the clip is walk, run, aim, shoot, hit, death or idle,
  // and anything held makes it carry a gun in its right hand. The pose comes only from the clip and the time, so a
  // replay, and the other phone, pose it the same.
  const RIG = {
    guard: { shirt: 0x5b6a3c, legs: 0x4a5431, skin: 0xc8976f, head: "cap", hat: 0x3d4829, hair: 0x2a1d14, boots: 0x1c1915 },
    soldier: { shirt: 0x3d4934, legs: 0x323b2a, skin: 0xb5875f, head: "helmet", hat: 0x2e3825, hair: 0x231a12, boots: 0x141310, vest: 0x262b1f },
    elite: { shirt: 0x1f2125, legs: 0x18191c, skin: 0x9c7252, head: "mask", hat: 0x101113, hair: 0x101113, boots: 0x0c0c0d, vest: 0x2b2d31 },
    scientist: { shirt: 0xe9edf0, legs: 0x586071, skin: 0xd8ad8a, head: "bare", hat: 0, hair: 0x6a5846, boots: 0x2a2620, coat: true, glasses: true },
    agent: { shirt: 0x3a3e46, legs: 0x2d3037, skin: 0xc99f7e, head: "bare", hat: 0, hair: 0x1e160f, boots: 0x111111, tie: 0x7a1f22, collar: 0xe8e8e8 },
  };
  const rigMats = new Map();
  const rigMat = c => { let m = rigMats.get(c); if (!m) { m = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: c }); rigMats.set(c, m); } return m; };
  const hexOf = n => "#" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
  function faceTexture(d) {
    const c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = c.height = 16; const g = c.getContext("2d");
    g.fillStyle = hexOf(d.skin); g.fillRect(0, 0, 16, 16);
    if (d.head === "mask") { g.fillStyle = hexOf(d.hat); g.fillRect(0, 0, 16, 16); g.fillStyle = hexOf(d.skin); g.fillRect(2, 5, 12, 4); }
    else { g.fillStyle = hexOf(d.hair); g.fillRect(0, 0, 16, 3); g.fillRect(0, 3, 1, 3); g.fillRect(15, 3, 1, 3); }
    g.fillStyle = "#00000055"; g.fillRect(3, 5, 4, 1); g.fillRect(9, 5, 4, 1);
    g.fillStyle = "#f4f1ea"; g.fillRect(4, 6, 2, 2); g.fillRect(10, 6, 2, 2);
    g.fillStyle = "#1a1410"; g.fillRect(5, 6, 1, 2); g.fillRect(10, 6, 1, 2);
    if (d.head !== "mask") { g.fillStyle = "#00000022"; g.fillRect(7, 8, 2, 3); g.fillStyle = "#7a4a3a"; g.fillRect(6, 12, 4, 1); }
    if (d.glasses) { g.strokeStyle = "#2a2a2a"; g.lineWidth = 1; g.strokeRect(3.5, 5.5, 4, 3); g.strokeRect(8.5, 5.5, 4, 3); }
    const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; t.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter; return t;
  }
  const rigBox = (w, h, d, mat, x, y, z, parent) => { const m = new THREE.Mesh(unitBox, mat); m.scale.set(w, h, d); m.position.set(x, y, z); parent.add(m); return m; };
  const rigJoint = (x, y, z, parent) => { const g = new THREE.Group(); g.position.set(x, y, z); parent.add(g); return g; };
  // one unit tall, facing +z like the model files; the figure's right is -x
  function buildRig(kind) {
    const d = RIG[kind] || RIG.guard, body = new THREE.Group(), j = {};
    const shirt = rigMat(d.shirt), legs = rigMat(d.legs), skin = rigMat(d.skin), boots = rigMat(d.boots);
    j.hips = rigJoint(0, 0.52, 0, body);
    rigBox(0.2, 0.08, 0.12, legs, 0, 0, 0, j.hips);
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
      const side = s < 0 ? "R" : "L", hip = rigJoint(s * 0.055, -0.02, 0, j.hips), knee = rigJoint(0, -0.235, 0, hip);
      rigBox(0.088, 0.24, 0.1, legs, 0, -0.115, 0, hip); rigBox(0.076, 0.22, 0.086, legs, 0, -0.1, 0, knee);
      rigBox(0.082, 0.045, 0.14, boots, 0, -0.226, 0.025, knee);
      j["leg" + side] = hip; j["knee" + side] = knee;
    }
    j.spine = rigJoint(0, 0.035, 0, j.hips);
    rigBox(0.23, 0.3, 0.13, shirt, 0, 0.15, 0, j.spine);
    if (d.vest) rigBox(0.245, 0.19, 0.152, rigMat(d.vest), 0, 0.18, 0, j.spine);
    if (d.coat) rigBox(0.245, 0.27, 0.145, shirt, 0, -0.08, 0, j.spine);
    if (d.collar) rigBox(0.07, 0.1, 0.012, rigMat(d.collar), 0, 0.235, 0.066, j.spine);
    if (d.tie) rigBox(0.028, 0.17, 0.014, rigMat(d.tie), 0, 0.19, 0.072, j.spine);
    j.neck = rigJoint(0, 0.305, 0, j.spine);
    rigBox(0.055, 0.04, 0.055, skin, 0, 0.012, 0, j.neck);
    const hair = rigMat(d.hair), headMats = [skin, skin, hair, skin, new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: faceTexture(d) }), hair];
    j.head = new THREE.Mesh(unitBox, headMats); j.head.scale.set(0.1, 0.12, 0.11); j.head.position.set(0, 0.092, 0); j.neck.add(j.head);
    if (d.head === "cap") { rigBox(0.11, 0.032, 0.116, rigMat(d.hat), 0, 0.162, -0.002, j.neck); rigBox(0.1, 0.01, 0.06, rigMat(d.hat), 0, 0.15, 0.078, j.neck); }
    if (d.head === "helmet") { rigBox(0.126, 0.055, 0.13, rigMat(d.hat), 0, 0.168, -0.004, j.neck); rigBox(0.136, 0.02, 0.142, rigMat(d.hat), 0, 0.142, -0.002, j.neck); }
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
      const side = s < 0 ? "R" : "L", sh = rigJoint(s * 0.148, 0.285, 0, j.spine), el = rigJoint(0, -0.17, 0, sh), hand = rigJoint(0, -0.165, 0, el);
      rigBox(0.07, 0.18, 0.076, shirt, 0, -0.08, 0, sh); rigBox(0.062, 0.165, 0.066, d.coat ? shirt : shirt, 0, -0.078, 0, el);
      rigBox(0.054, 0.062, 0.06, skin, 0, -0.022, 0, hand);
````

## examples/silvereye.sp

Bunker 3D: Bunker's game code with a draw in 3D words, CC0 models and textures (Games group)

````sprout
-- SilverEye: five missions, proximity mines and turrets you program in Sprout, in low-poly 3D.
-- Alone, a campaign: the lab, the depot, the relay, then the compound and the quarry out under the sky. In each, take
-- down the guards, wreck the targets, take the intel and get out; keeping the scientists safe is a bonus. Guards hear
-- gunfire, so a silencer helps. A combat sim puts you against simulants; two phones play a duel or the campaign in
-- co-op, linked by an invite sent by text (no server). Mines and turrets go for whoever comes near, so lay traps.
-- On its own page (taskiap.com/silvereye) it plays on a pocket console: the stick moves and strafes (push it all the
-- way up to run), drag the screen to look, hold A to fire, B drops a mine, C-up sets down a turret, C-down turns round.
-- Keys: WASD to move and strafe, arrows to turn, space to fire, M for a mine, T for a turret.
-- In the editor's player: drag above or below the middle to walk, left or right to turn, tap the middle to fire.
-- The turrets run turret-program and the simulants simulant-program, in plain words (it sees-someone, it how-far):
-- change one while you play and they think the new way at once, on both phones. Every number below can be changed too.
-- A love letter to GoldenEye 007 (Rare, 1997) and Perfect Dark (Rare, 2000): their ideas, our own maps and art.
-- Characters, props and the turret by Quaternius, the blasters from Kenney's Blaster Kit, textures by Screaming Brain
-- Studios (all CC0, credited in vendor/models/README.md).

-- the maps are our own: the lab, the depot (rows of shelving round a loading bay) and the relay indoors, the compound
-- and the quarry out in the open. Any of them but the relay can be the arena for a match.

-- moving
walk-pace : 2.6             -- metres a second at a walk
walk-speed : walk-pace * (cond [turbo, 1.5, any, 1])
run-boost : 1.4            -- the stick pushed all the way up runs this much faster
turn-speed : 2.4            -- how fast the keys and simulants turn, in radians a second
-- mines
mine-arm : 1.2             -- seconds before a dropped mine is live
mine-reach : 1.0           -- how close someone must come to set it off
blast : 2.1                -- how far the blast reaches
mines-each : 4             -- mines you carry
-- turrets
sentries : 2               -- turrets you carry
sentry-reach : 7           -- how far a turret can see
sentry-turn : 2.5          -- how fast it can turn, in radians a second
sentry-reload : 0.45       -- seconds between its shots
sentry-damage : 34         -- a turret's shot
-- guards
hearing : 7                -- how far off a guard hears your shot, through walls (the heavy blaster half as far again)
-- shots
shot-damage : 50           -- your shot at a guard
duel-damage : 34           -- a shot at another player
steady-damage : 50         -- the same shot while aiming
fire-every : 0.25          -- hold fire and it fires this often
clip-size : 8              -- shots before you reload
ammo-each : 48             -- spare shots you start with
reload-time : 1.1          -- seconds to reload
heavy-spot : [12.5, 9.5]   -- where the heavy blaster lies
heavy-every : 0.6          -- the heavy blaster fires this often
heavy-damage : 70          -- and hits this hard (110 on a guard)
-- matches and missions
pickup-back : 20           -- seconds before a pickup is back, in a match
pickup-spots : [["ammo", 5.5, 1.5], ["armour", 8.5, 5.5], ["ammo", 14.5, 8.5], ["armour", 3.5, 10.5], ["ammo", 9.5, 13.5], ["ammo", 1.5, 5.5]]
frag-limit : 5             -- takedowns to win a duel
respawn-after : 2.5        -- seconds before you're back in a duel
par-time : 180             -- finish a mission inside this for the time medal
time-limit : 300           -- a match ends after this many seconds; the most takedowns wins

-- where players start and come back in a match: indoors, out in the compound's yard, and in the quarry
````
